title: The Biggest Reason People Avoid AI Isn’t Complexity—It’s Privacy
description: How information shared with AI may be handled, which choices can reduce exposure, and how to build capability without dismissing legitimate privacy concerns.
aliasTitles: The Biggest Reason People Avoid AI Isn’t Complexity—It’s Privacy
The biggest reason people avoid AI isn’t complexity — it’s privacy. And honestly, that’s a very reasonable concern.
